_meta.description: What a suite's cases need from the stand that the suite CSV cannot express: a store setting, a platform setting, a payment method, a key in vc-deploy-dev infra/environments.yml (headers, FileUpload scopes, KnownAssetHosts). Read by the regression pre-flight (scripts/regression/requirements.ts) before every run and every release wave; personas ([PRE:SIGNIN_AS:*]) and fixtures (@td()) are derived from the CSVs and are NOT declared here.
_meta.kinds: storeSetting · platformSetting · paymentMethod (isActive) · deployConfig (dotted path in the env's block of infra/environments.yml; prefix:true for an indexed list) · uploadScope (a FileUpload__Scopes__N__Scope value) · contract (a generated contract snapshot the cases cite — mcp-schema | ucp-schema; runs its --check read-only, drift is a WARN whose remedy is the refresh then a re-read of the cases, never an automatic refresh)
_meta.match: equals · notEquals · nonEmpty · allowedIncludes (platformSetting: values its dictionary must offer) · (none = must be set). level: warn (default — the named cases will BLOCK) or block (the suite cannot run meaningfully).
_meta.personas: personas: a persona or @td() fixture alias (or PREFIX*) → the module it needs. Without that module on the stand its cases are NOT DEPLOYED: they leave the plan (not run, not counted, not triaged), like a suite whose requiresModules is not deployed.
_meta.skip: Every case a WARN/BLOCK row names is recorded BLOCKED with that row's reason and NOT run (regression:plan --run-blocked runs them anyway).
_meta.provenance: Every entry below was a BLOCKED or FAIL cause in the Stable 16 regression on vcptcore_regression (regression/releases/stable-16/), with the exact cases it hit. Names were read live from the platform API and from vc-deploy-dev infra/environments.yml on 2026-10-16. Add an entry when a triage verdict is ENV_CONFIG; remove one when the cases stop needing it.
